def subarraySum(nums, k):
    cnt = {0: 1}       # 前缀和 -> 出现次数
    pre = 0
    ans = 0
    for x in nums:
        pre += x
        ans += cnt.get(pre - k, 0)
        cnt[pre] = cnt.get(pre, 0) + 1
    return ans

def trap(height):
    left, right = 0, len(height) - 1
    left_max = right_max = 0
    ans = 0
    while left < right:
        if height[left] < height[right]:
            left_max = max(left_max, height[left])
            ans += left_max - height[left]
            left += 1
        else:
            right_max = max(right_max, height[right])
            ans += right_max - height[right]
            right -= 1
    return ans

def reverseList(head):
    prev = None
    cur = head
    while cur:
        nxt = cur.next      # 先记住后继
        cur.next = prev     # 掉头
        prev = cur          # prev 前进
        cur = nxt           # cur 前进
    return prev             # 新头节点

lc-102.code:
from collections import deque

def levelOrder(root):
    if not root:
        return []
    ans = []
    q = deque([root])
    while q:
        level = []
        for _ in range(len(q)):   # 锁死本层节点数
            node = q.popleft()
            level.append(node.val)
            if node.left:
                q.append(node.left)
            if node.right:
                q.append(node.right)
        ans.append(level)
    return ans

lc-207.title: 课程表
lc-207.code:
from collections import deque

def canFinish(numCourses, prerequisites):
    g = [[] for _ in range(numCourses)]
    indeg = [0] * numCourses
    for a, b in prerequisites:      # 先修 b 再修 a
        g[b].append(a)
        indeg[a] += 1
    q = deque(i for i in range(numCourses)
              if indeg[i] == 0)
    done = 0
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        done += 1
        for v in g[u]:
            indeg[v] -= 1
            if indeg[v] == 0:
                q.append(v)
    return done == numCourses

import torch

def softmax(x):
    x = x - x.max()      # 先减最大值，防止 exp 溢出
    e = torch.exp(x)
    return e / e.sum()   # 归一化，所有元素和为 1

import torch

def rms_norm(x, weight, eps=1e-6):
    ms = x.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    rms = torch.sqrt(ms + eps)
    return x / rms * weight

llm-11.code:
import math
import torch

def attention(Q, K, V, mask=None):
    d_k = Q.size(-1)
    scores = Q @ K.transpose(-2, -1) / math.sqrt(d_k)
    if mask is not None:
        scores = scores.masked_fill(mask == 0,
                                      float('-inf'))
    weights = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    return weights @ V

import torch

def causal_attention(scores):
    T = scores.size(-1)
    mask = torch.tril(torch.ones(T, T))       # 下三角 = 1
    scores = scores.masked_fill(mask == 0,
                                float('-inf'))
    return torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)

llm-15.title: Multi-Head Attention
llm-15.code:
import torch
import math

def mha(x, W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, h):
    B, T, D = x.shape
    dk = D // h
    Q = x @ W_q                     # [B,T,D]，K、V 同理
    Q = Q.view(B, T, h, dk).transpose(1, 2)   # 头维前置
    K = (x @ W_k).view(B, T, h, dk).transpose(1, 2)
    V = (x @ W_v).view(B, T, h, dk).transpose(1, 2)
    scores = Q @ K.transpose(-2, -1) / math.sqrt(dk)
    attn = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    out = attn @ V                  # [B,h,T,dk]
    out = out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, T, D)  # 合并头
    return out @ W_o

import torch
import math

def gqa(Q, K, V, h_q, h_kv):
    # Q: [h_q, T, dk]，K/V: [h_kv, T, dk]
    rep = h_q // h_kv
    K = K.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=0)   # rep 个 Q 头共享
    V = V.repeat_interleave(rep, dim=0)
    scores = Q @ K.transpose(-2, -1) / Q.size(-1) ** 0.5
    attn = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    return attn @ V

llm-20.code:
import torch
import math

@torch.no_grad()
def generate(K_cache, V_cache, q_t, k_t, v_t):
    # 每步只算新 token 的 k, v 并追加到缓存
    K_cache = torch.cat([K_cache, k_t], dim=0)
    V_cache = torch.cat([V_cache, v_t], dim=0)
    scores = q_t @ K_cache.T / math.sqrt(q_t.size(-1))
    attn = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    return attn @ V_cache, K_cache, V_cache

llm-23.title: FlashAttention 分块计算
llm-23.code:
import torch
import math

def flash_row(q, K, V, B):
    m, l = float('-inf'), 0.0      # 运行 max / 归一和
    acc = torch.zeros(q.size(-1))
    for s in range(0, K.size(0), B):
        Kb, Vb = K[s:s + B], V[s:s + B]      # 载一块
        sj = q @ Kb.T / math.sqrt(q.size(-1))
        m_new = max(m, sj.max())
        alpha = math.exp(m - m_new)          # 旧量缩放
        beta = torch.exp(sj - m_new)         # 新块权重
        l = l * alpha + beta.sum()
        acc = acc * alpha + beta @ Vb
        m = m_new
    return acc / l

llm-27.title: 正弦位置编码
llm-27.code:
import torch
import math

def sinusoidal_pe(T, d, base=10000):
    P = torch.zeros(T, d)
    pos = torch.arange(T).unsqueeze(1)        # [T,1]
    i = torch.arange(0, d, 2)                 # [d/2]
    omega = base ** (-i / d)                  # 频率随维衰减
    P[:, 0::2] = torch.sin(pos * omega)       # 偶数维 sin
    P[:, 1::2] = torch.cos(pos * omega)       # 奇数维 cos
    return P

llm-29.title: RoPE 旋转位置编码
llm-29.code:
import torch
import math

def rope(x, base=10000):
    T, d = x.shape                      # d 为偶数
    out = torch.zeros_like(x)
    for pos in range(T):
        for i in range(0, d, 2):
            theta = pos * base ** (-i / d)
            c, s = math.cos(theta), math.sin(theta)
            a, b = x[pos, i], x[pos, i + 1]
            out[pos, i]     = a * c - b * s
            out[pos, i + 1] = a * s + b * c
    return out

llm-35.title: MoE Top-k 路由
llm-35.code:
import torch

def moe_forward(x, W_gate, experts, k):
    logits = x @ W_gate                    # [T, E]
    probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
    topv, topi = probs.topk(k, dim=-1)     # 选 k 个专家
    w = topv / topv.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)   # 重新归一化
    out = torch.zeros_like(x)
    for t in range(x.size(0)):
        for j in range(k):
            e = topi[t, j]
            out[t] += w[t, j] * experts[e](x[t])
    return out

llm-53.title: Top-p 采样
llm-53.code:
import torch

def top_p_sample(logits, p, u):
    probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
    sorted_p, idx = probs.sort(descending=True)
    cum = sorted_p.cumsum(-1)
    keep = cum - sorted_p <= p        # 保留 ≤p 的核
    sorted_p = sorted_p * keep
    sorted_p = sorted_p / sorted_p.sum()   # 重新归一化
    cum = sorted_p.cumsum(-1)
    j = (cum < u).sum()               # u 落在哪个 token
    return idx[j]

llm-74.title: LoRA Linear
llm-74.code:
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

class LoRALinear(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, W, r, alpha):
        super().__init__()
        self.W = W                   # 冻结权重
        self.A = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(r, W.size(1)))
        self.B = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(W.size(0), r))
        self.s = alpha / r
    def forward(self, x):
        return (x @ self.W.T
                + self.s * x @ self.A.T @ self.B.T)
    def merge(self):
        return self.W + self.s * self.B @ self.A   # 零延迟

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def dpo_loss(lp_pol_c, lp_pol_r,
             lp_ref_c, lp_ref_r, beta):
    # 每条：policy 相对 ref 对 chosen / rejected 的偏好差
    logit = beta * ((lp_pol_c - lp_ref_c)
                    - (lp_pol_r - lp_ref_r))
    return -F.logsigmoid(logit).mean()

llm-85.title: PPO Clip 目标

import torch

def ppo_clip_loss(lp_new, lp_old, adv, eps=0.2):
    ratio = torch.exp(lp_new - lp_old)      # 新旧概率比
    s1 = ratio * adv
    s2 = torch.clamp(ratio, 1 - eps, 1 + eps) * adv
    loss = -torch.min(s1, s2).mean()
    return loss

llm-89.title: GRPO 组内优势
llm-89.code:
import torch

def grpo(rewards, lp_new, lp_old,
         lp_ref, eps=0.2, beta=0.04):
    mean = rewards.mean()
    std = rewards.std(unbiased=False)
    adv = (rewards - mean) / (std + 1e-8)    # 组内相对优势
    ratio = torch.exp(lp_new - lp_old)
    s1 = ratio * adv
    s2 = torch.clamp(ratio, 1 - eps, 1 + eps) * adv
    d = lp_ref - lp_new
    kl = d.exp() - d - 1                     # k3 估计
    loss = -(torch.min(s1, s2) - beta * kl).mean()
    return adv, loss
